page.overview:
What is Sixfold Path of Transmigration?

The is a place in the Underworld where souls go to be reincarnated.

The Sixfold Path of Transmigration is a junction set beneath the Wheel of Transmigration where all souls who are to be reincarnated are sent down one of six predetermined paths.

Those who perform good deeds will reincarnate as gods. Those who were patriotic will reincarnate as nobles. Those who practiced piety will reincarnate into a good mortal life. Those who were just and honest will reincarnate as a normal human. Those who were virtuous will reincarnate into a wealthy life. Those who sinned and were violent will reincarnate as demons.
